import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import sys

sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()/'tools'))
import test_sdx_firmware_demo as firmware_demo
from test_cartridge import run as cartridge
from test_demo import run as demo
from native_program import ROOT,require,sha256

BASE=ROOT/'build/release-0.2.2'
BUNDLE=BASE/'tagged-demo'
Original=firmware_demo.Smoke
class ReleaseSmoke(Original):
    def exercise(self,session):
        command=session.command
        def checked(text,*args,**kwargs):
            output=command(text,*args,**kwargs)
            if text=='VER':
                require(b'Exec816 0.2.2 (v0.2.2)' in output,'Final executable has wrong release banner')
                require(b'-dirty' not in output,'Dirty release version')
                session.saved['release_banner']='Exec816 0.2.2 (v0.2.2)'
            if text=='TYPE WORK:FW.TXT':
                command('FBI WORK:HELLO.BAS',b'HELLO BASIC')
                command('FB WORK:CALC.BAS',b'3.75')
                session.saved['packaged_fastbasic_run']=True
            return output
        session.command=checked
        super().exercise(session)

if __name__=='__main__':
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--rom',type=Path,required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--route',choices=('atr','new','old','xex'),required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--name',required=True)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    out=BASE/args.name
    firmware_demo.Smoke=ReleaseSmoke
    if args.route=='xex':
        out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        private=out/'demo'
        shutil.copytree(BUNDLE,private,dirs_exist_ok=True)
        media=out/'system.atr'
        shutil.copyfile(BUNDLE/'exec816.atr',media)
        result=demo(private,boot_smoke=True,media_path=media,
                    rom_override=args.rom.resolve(),integration=ReleaseSmoke(),boot_route='xex')
        record=dict(status='pass',route='xex',results=result,
                    rom_sha256=sha256(args.rom),qualification=False)
    elif args.route=='old':
        result=cartridge(BUNDLE/'cartridge',BUNDLE,ROOT,out,'old',True,
                         rom_override=args.rom.resolve(),integration=ReleaseSmoke())
        record=dict(status='pass',route='old-manual',results=result,
                    rom_sha256=sha256(args.rom),qualification=False)
    else:
        record=firmware_demo.run(BUNDLE,args.rom.resolve(),out,
                                'atr' if args.route=='atr' else 'cart')
    record['release_observer_sha256']=sha256(Path(__file__))
    record['release_banner']='Exec816 0.2.2 (v0.2.2)'
    record['packaged_fastbasic_run']=True
    (out/'release-smoke.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')

import copy
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()/'tools'))
import audit_xlos_sdx as audit
import test_sdx_runtime as component
from generate_sdx_firmware import identify
from native_program import sha256
from sdx_firmware_stack import support_bound

root=Path.cwd()
out=root/'build/release-0.2.2/firmware-matrix'
out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
roms=[root/'build/firmware/altirraos-816.rom',
      Path('/Users/michalkurcewicz/xlos-20251207/XLOS816F.ROM'),
      root/'build/xlos-sdx-audit/firmware/xlos-20261007/XLOS816F.ROM']
report=dict(status='running',tier='release-preparation',qualification=False,
            scope='Complete selected firmware boundary/component placement and transition matrix; full hosted-system qualification remains pending',
            pin=audit.PIN,pin_sha256=sha256(audit.PIN_PATH),roms=[],
            exclusions=['Phase 2 injects inside an owned hardware IRQ, so it is unreachable with I set. Masked cases cover phases 0, 1, 3 and 4.'])
try:
    for rom in roms:
        profile=identify(rom.read_bytes())
        case=dict(firmware=profile,native=[],component=[])
        report['roms'].append(case)
        directory=out/profile['name']
        if profile['name'].startswith('xlos-'):
            case['stack_bound']=support_bound(rom)
            for kind,flags in [(0,0xcb|width|mask) for width in (0,16,32,48) for mask in (0,4)]+[(1,0)]:
                case['native'].append(audit.native_case(rom,directory/f'native-{kind}-{flags:02x}',kind,flags))
        pin=copy.deepcopy(audit.PIN)
        pin['rom']={k:profile[k] for k in ('name','bytes','sha256')}
        component.SOURCE=root/'probes/sdx-runtime'
        component.ROM=rom
        component.PIN=pin
        component.BRIDGE=audit.BRIDGE
        component.emulator=audit.diskboot
        for bank in (2,3):
            for flags in (0xe9,0xed):
                for phase in range(5):
                    if flags & 4 and phase==2:
                        continue
                    result=component.execute(directory/f'guest-{bank}-{flags:02x}-{phase}',
                        bank,0x2200 if bank==2 else 0x2100,flags,
                        0xabcd if bank==2 else 0x1265,phase)
                    case['component'].append(result)
        print(profile['name'],len(case['native']),'native;',len(case['component']),'components passed',flush=True)
    report['status']='pass'
except Exception as error:
    report.update(status='fail',error=str(error))
    raise
finally:
    report['source_inputs']={n:sha256(root/n) for n in (
        'platform/altirraos/sdx-rom-shadow.s','platform/altirraos/sdx-firmware.json',
        'platform/altirraos/generated/sdx-firmware.inc','probes/sdx-runtime/probe.s',
        'probes/xlos-sdx/boundary.s','tools/audit_xlos_sdx.py','tools/test_sdx_runtime.py',
        'tools/sdx_firmware_stack.py')}
    report['observer_sha256']=sha256(Path(__file__))
    (out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')

import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()/'tools'))
from test_sdx_resident_stack import probe
from generate_sdx_firmware import identify
from native_program import ROOT,sha256

base=ROOT/'build/release-0.2.2/resident-matrix'
base.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
roms=[ROOT/'build/firmware/altirraos-816.rom',
      Path('/Users/michalkurcewicz/xlos-20251207/XLOS816F.ROM'),
      ROOT/'build/xlos-sdx-audit/firmware/xlos-20261007/XLOS816F.ROM']
report=dict(status='running',tier='release-preparation',qualification=False,cases=[])
try:
    for rom in roms:
        profile=identify(rom.read_bytes())
        for mode in ('opt','raw'):
            directory=base/profile['name']/mode
            groups=[('deep',0x190,0,0,True,False),
                    ('bounds-accepted',0x190,0,0,False,False),
                    ('bounds-rejected',0x18f,1,0,False,False)]
            groups += [(f'borrow-{phase}',0x1d0,0,phase,False,False) for phase in range(1,5)]
            groups += [(f'lease-{phase}',0x1d0,0,phase,False,True) for phase in range(5,8)]
            for name,anchor,expected,phase,deep,lease in groups:
                case=probe(directory/name,mode,anchor,expected,phase,deep,lease,rom)
                report['cases'].append(dict(firmware=profile,name=name,**case))
                print(profile['name'],mode,name,case['checks'],'checks',flush=True)
    report['status']='pass'
except Exception as error:
    report.update(status='fail',error=str(error))
    raise
finally:
    report['observer_sha256']=sha256(Path(__file__))
    (base/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
